headline: Bank of Uganda Raises Benchmark Rate by 225 Basis Points to 12%
summary: The Bank of Uganda raised its Central Bank Rate by 2.25 percentage points to 12%, citing mounting risks from elevated global oil prices, currency weakness, and rising food inflation.
why: The Bank of Uganda's policy shifts aim to anchor foreign exchange stability and prevent imported energy shocks from embedding into headline inflation.

impacts.name: Uganda
impacts.why: A steep 225 bps rate increase supports the Ugandan shilling against imported inflation while dampening domestic private credit growth.
